narrative.overview: MainGa? is a dark room with the games lit and the furniture invisible. The canvas is near-black carbon, the game covers are the only photography, and a single voltage-lime control marks the thing you can press. Everything else — chrome, metadata, dividers, secondary buttons — sits in graphite steps and 65%-white text so it can be scanned without competing with the posters. The metaphor is an arcade at night: many cabinets, one lit coin slot. The system is deliberately flat and tonal. Depth is expressed by stepping the surface (near-black → graphite → raised graphite), not by shadows, gradients, or glow. Lime is rationed under a 60-30-10 rule: black owns the room, white carries text and selection, lime appears on roughly one tenth of a screen and always means "act here" or "active now". The product's question — main apa hari ini? — is answered by hierarchy, not decoration: a bold title, a poster, a status chip, a price. The interface voice is Indonesian, direct, and non-technical. The visual register follows: no gamified badges, no RGB, no storefront merchandising. This is a personal ledger presented like a curated shelf.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black canvas with three graphite surface steps as the only depth system.
One accent: voltage lime at ≤10% of the view, always paired with near-black ink.
Poster-led lists: 3:4 game covers carry the imagery; typography stays quiet around them.
Pill controls against 20px content surfaces; 1px ash hairlines instead of shadows.
Tabular numerals for every changing value: prices, hours, ratings, counters.
Motion is short (150–300 ms), cubic ease-out, and disabled under reduce-motion.
Indonesian copy in sentence case; status names are fixed terms, never synonyms.

rules.name: The One Lit Cabinet Rule
rules.body: Lime occupies at most about a tenth of any screen. It may fill a button, a tab pill, a focus ring, or a data mark; it may never fill a page, app bar, card, or paragraph.

rules.name: The Black-on-Lime Rule
rules.body: Everything placed on lime uses #0B0B0C. White on lime is forbidden: contrast collapses to roughly 1.2:1.

rules.name: The Desaturated Witness Rule
rules.body: Status and functional colors appear only as 12–25% tinted chips, badges, and icons. They never become large surfaces, and they never outshine lime.

rules.name: The Tabular Truth Rule
rules.body: Any number that can change while the user watches — price, hours, rating, counters — uses tabular figures (FontFeature.tabularFigures()), so digits do not shift width between frames.

rules.name: The Two-Tone Text Rule
rules.body: Primary copy is #FFFFFF; everything secondary is #FFFFFFA6. Muted metadata drops to #FFFFFF61. Lime is never used for body copy, only for emphasis on a value that is already short.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: No multi-column grids, no side-by-side content panels, no tablet reflow. Lists are single-column and full-bleed to the gutters; the screen is a shelf, not a dashboard.

rules.name: The 16-Gutter Rule
rules.body: Every screen edge starts at 16dp. Nested padding may add 8 or 12, but nothing may reduce the gutter below 16dp on a phone.

rules.name: The Tone-Step Rule
rules.body: When something must feel closer, raise its surface one step and add or strengthen a 1px border. Do not reach for a shadow.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: The dock is the only shadowed object in the product. If a new surface needs a shadow to read, the surface choice is wrong.

rules.name: The Pill-for-Controls Rule
rules.body: If the user can press it, it is a pill. If the user reads inside it, it is a 20px rectangle. Never invert the two.

rules.name: The Poster Crop Rule
rules.body: Game imagery is always a 3:4 portrait crop (88×118, 78×106, 50×66) with a 14px radius or smaller. No landscape banners, no full-bleed hero photography.

dos: Do hold lime to roughly a tenth of the screen and reserve it for the primary action, the active tab, focus, and data marks.
Do place near-black #0B0B0C ink on every lime surface.
Do build depth with the #0B0B0C → #141416 → #1C1C1F → #26262B steps and 1px #2A2A2E hairlines.
Do use 20px radii for content surfaces and 999px for every pressable control.
Do keep game covers at a 3:4 portrait crop.
Do use Plus Jakarta Sans at the documented role sizes, with tabular figures for prices, hours, ratings, and counters.
Do keep touch targets at 48dp or larger, layouts legible at font scale 1.3, and motion disabled when reduce-motion is on.
Do keep the five status terms exact: Wishlist, Backlog, Sedang Dimainkan, Tamat, Dropped.
donts: Don't use white text or icons on lime; the contrast is unreadable.
Don't use lime as a page, app-bar, card, or paragraph background.
Don't introduce RGB gamer neon, glow, neon gradients, or a second accent color.
Don't add drop shadows to cards, sheets, buttons, or inputs; the dock is the only shadow.
Don't hardcode colors outside lib/core/theme/app_colors.dart, and don't bypass AppTypography, AppSpacing, AppRadius, or AppMotion with magic numbers.
Don't turn status colors into large fills, progress bars, or decorative blocks; keep them at 12–25% tint.
Don't use emoji, sticker badges, gamified trophies, or storefront-style promo banners.
Don't port iOS controls, hide the system Back gesture, or replace the floating dock with a stock Material navigation bar.
Don't fabricate numbers, ratings, prices, or SUS/test results to fill a layout; empty and loading states are part of the system.
